# ModDotPlot Browser v0.9.7

**Note:** This file was generated by ChatGPT 5.6 Sol under the direction of Adam Phillippy.

v0.9.7 improves shared-link previews and makes complete overview grids reproducible in
the official ModDotPlot CLI.

The GitHub Pages document now publishes Open Graph and large-card metadata that points
to the bundled `browser_1.png` artwork. Link unfurlers such as Slack can retrieve a real
PNG with declared dimensions instead of showing an empty image placeholder.

Grid mode now keeps **Export ModDotPlot command** available after all comparisons finish.
Its ZIP package includes one BEDPE for each selected self plot and each unique pairwise
plot. A companion JSON config preserves selected sequence order and display settings,
sets `grid_only`, lists every BEDPE under `load`, and records the complete command:

```console
moddotplot --grid-only -c name.config.json -l self-a.bedpe self-b.bedpe pair-a-vs-b.bedpe
```

The grid's **Plot window size** now reports the genomic bases per displayed pixel using
the longest selected sequence and the common 512-cell grid scale. Smaller sequences
retain their size-proportional footprint without implying a different display-pixel
window.
